# Overview

This course is split into 2 main parts: the course materials, and the optional/additional materials.

## Course materials


## Extra materials

There are extra materials you can attempt after the workshop. 

### Plots

The [plots](/plots/plots_intro.qmd) part includes creating:

- [Line graphs](/plots/line.qmd)
- [Histograms](/plots/histogram.qmd)
- [Scatterplots](/plots/scatter.qmd)
- [Boxplots](/plots/boxplot.qmd) 

### Statistics

The [statistics](/stats/stats_overview.qmd) part will cover carrying out:

- [Linear regression](/stats/linear_regression.qmd)
- [T-test](/stats/t_test.qmd)

### Programming

Finally, the last part will introduce some harder coding where you'll learn to create:

- [Loops](programming/loop_types.qmd)
- [If statements](programming/if.qmd)
- [Custom functions](/programming/functions.qmd)
